set.zoneDetail.dnssecNotActiveBody: When DNSSEC is off, there is no DS data to publish. You can enable it now (PowerDNS will create keys and DS digests), or tick “Enable DNSSEC immediately” when creating a new zone.
set.zones.dnssecRegistrarBody: KSK + ZSK (or a CSK) will be generated. You must add the DS record at your registrar. After the zone exists, open Zone details for that domain – the DS lines appear in the yellow “DS records for your domain registrar” box at the top (not in the “Add record” form).
set.zoneDetail.txtTooLong_one: Long ({{count}} character) – will be split into 255-character chunks in DNS.
set.zoneDetail.txtTooLong_other: Long ({{count}} characters) – will be split into 255-character chunks in DNS.
